request.query: Two elements of the closed interval [a,b] have absolute difference at most b-a

items.name: Real.dist_le_of_mem_Icc
items.type: ∀ {x y x' y' : ℝ}, x ∈ Set.Icc x' y' → y ∈ Set.Icc x' y' → dist x y ≤ y' - x'

items.name: abs_sub_le_of_le_of_le
items.type:
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommGroup G] [inst_1 : LinearOrder G] [IsOrderedAddMonoid G] {a b lb ub : G},
  lb ≤ a → a ≤ ub → lb ≤ b → b ≤ ub → |a - b| ≤ ub - lb

items.name: Set.abs_sub_left_of_mem_uIcc
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommGroup α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [IsOrderedAddMonoid α] {a b c : α},
  c ∈ Set.uIcc a b → |c - a| ≤ |b - a|

items.name: Real.dist_le_of_mem_uIcc
items.type: ∀ {x y x' y' : ℝ}, x ∈ Set.uIcc x' y' → y ∈ Set.uIcc x' y' → dist x y ≤ dist x' y'

items.name: Real.dist_le_of_mem_Icc_01
items.type: ∀ {x y : ℝ}, x ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 → y ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 → dist x y ≤ 1

items.name: Set.abs_sub_right_of_mem_uIcc
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommGroup α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [IsOrderedAddMonoid α] {a b c : α},
  c ∈ Set.uIcc a b → |b - c| ≤ |b - a|
